question: Does remaining C3 churn concentrate in changed-pivot first-unfrozen L3 subtrees?
baseline: Current P2 PAR+FULL, not Safe-C1. Existing PRE_R1/PRE_R2 and R1_C3/R2_C3 construction snapshots and actual L3 scoring evidence only.
timing_scope: No timing, profiling, throughput or performance comparison. CPU-only postprocessing of frozen measured evidence.

hardware_provenance.settings: unchanged in original campaign; not changed or used here

correspondence: Unique mutual maximum overlap of common live immutable occurrences at L3. Numeric node IDs never establish correspondence; ties/unmatched/missing evidence are UNKNOWN.
group_assignment: Classify each POST L3 parent by equality of actual PRE and POST selected pivot occurrence in its matched PRE parent. Assign each common live object by its POST L3 parent. Assign each POST leaf by its POST L3 ancestor. This partitions all residual counts, including imports. Report retained-in-matched-parent mechanics, imports/exports, and PRE-cohort object sensitivity separately.
primary: Exact sorted immutable occurrence membership for leaf identity; exact actual pivot occurrence for groups; exact child segment for crossings. Full leaf signatures retain non-common occurrences. No fuzzy gate.
l4_survival: PRE L4 selected pivots whose occurrence identity appears among actual L4 selected pivots under the matched POST L3 parent / all ten PRE L4 pivots per matched L3 parent. Report paired L4 correspondence equality separately; do not confuse global inventory survival with paired survival.
rank: Absolute within-parent full sorted-rank drift and drift divided by PRE parent size; p50/p90/p95/p99/max. Only common occurrences retained in corresponding parent enter mechanics. Also report common-only compressed ranks, exact encoded-key bits, actual input ranks, tie participation and persistent common tie-subgroup relative ordering. Encoded-key ties are not raw Euclidean-distance equality.
boundary: Nine actual 10-way split boundaries; report per-boundary counts, unique objects crossing >=1, and objects crossing multiple. Summed boundary counts are not unique objects.

gates.PIVOT_DOMINANT: Both rebuilds: changed-pivot group >=90% of residual object churn AND >=90% of residual leaf churn, SAME_PIVOT within-group leaf churn <=10%
gates.MIXED_CAUSE: If dominant gate fails and changed-pivot shares are in 50-90% with material same-pivot residuals; report exact counts, do not invent an unstated materiality threshold
gates.NO_GO_PIVOT_ONLY: Residual changed-pivot shares <50% or high same-pivot churn; report any mixed/inconclusive cross-rebuild outcome without forcing a pass

negative_evidence: R2 C1 changed 99986 leaves versus C0 99985. Root-only stabilization is insufficient and inconsistent; strict monotonic and <=20% strong gates from previous campaign remain unmet.
next_action: Only after PIVOT_DOMINANT may a separate prior-art Gate 0 begin. This attribution does not itself prove a new mechanism or authorize production promotion.
